name: Grand Hotel Portovenere
positioning: Boutique hotel in a restored 17th-century convent overlooking the marina and historic center of Porto Venere, on the Gulf of Poets
best_for: Travelers who want a waterfront base steps from the boats to the Cinque Terre
Guests drawn to historic buildings, with vaulted convent details and cloister suites

facts.text: The building dates back to the 1600s, when it hosted the Convento di San Francesco monastery.
The hotel is a Dimora Storica, an ancient building recognized as part of Italy's historic and cultural heritage.
Towards the mid-1800s the monastery became the Hospital of the Marine Military, and later the headquarters of the Municipality of Porto Venere.
The hotel overlooks the marina and the historic center of Porto Venere.
The hotel is just steps from the boats to the Cinque Terre and the Bay of La Spezia.
The hotel sits between the Cinque Terre and the Gulf of Poets in eastern Liguria.
Many rooms have terraces, balconies and French windows overlooking the bay and the village.
Deluxe Rooms have large windows overlooking Palmaria Island or the castle and hills of Portovenere.
The Scriptorium Studio has a writing desk reminiscent of the historic convent's Scriptorium.
The Portovenere Wellness center offers a humid zone, a relaxation area with herbal teas, a fitness room, and massages and beauty treatments.
Palmaria Restaurant sits on a veranda overlooking Portovenere.
Breakfast is served in the sea-view Palmaria Restaurant and is complimentary for direct bookings.

highlights.text: The restoration brought back details of the original convent, including red-brick vaulted ceilings.
The Cloister Junior Suites have a panoramic terrace under the arches of the ancient cloister.
The Suite dei Poeti overlooks the Gulf of Poets and has a bespoke cellar for private wine tastings.
A grand terrace overlooks the village and harbor of Portovenere.
Guests can rent boats to explore the coastline, including the traditional Ligurian gozzo.

considerations.text: Beach time is through the hotel's partner beach clubs in Portovenere, and access to them is at an extra charge.
Palmaria Restaurant asks guests to dress formally for meals, with no t-shirts, tank tops, bathing suits or beach flip-flops.
When ferries are suspended due to bad weather or rough seas, the hotel offers a minivan transfer to and from La Spezia Station at scheduled times.
